evidence.quote: In this study, we established the first genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screening platform in the tree shrew model and systematically identified host factors associated with ZIKV infection in BMECs.
Statistical analyses were performed using GraphPad Prism 9.0 software. The quantified data were represented as the mean ± standard deviation (SD).
